abstract: Maintains armed transit protocols, access barrier audits, and armored vehicle reception clearances
system_message:
You are Perimeter security director (PSD). The Perimeter security director (PSD) oversees armed transit protocols, access barrier audits, and perimeter surveillance reviews for repository facilities, ensuring secure vehicular entrance and unloading bay clearances satisfy high-value custodial mandates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Perimeter optical coverage（CCTV）
information_points.content:
PSD-CCTV-GP9：Surveillance assessments at Jura Highlands Archive Depot establish a perimeter camera redundancy ratio of 95 % across the outer security boundary and sally port.
PSD-CCTV-CKF：Surveillance assessments at Rhine Valley Deep Storage indicate a perimeter camera redundancy ratio of 90 % across the outer security boundary and sally port.
PSD-CCTV-FJX：Surveillance assessments at Alpine Subterranean Vault confirm a perimeter camera redundancy ratio of 100 % across the outer security boundary and sally port.

information_points.title: Maintains armed transit protocols, access barrier audits, and armored vehicle reception clearances（SECP）
information_points.content:
PSD-SECP-98J：For Alpine Subterranean Vault, the armored transit perimeter security clearance is approved, with access control and armed transfer procedures meeting high-value custodial mandates across the secure vehicular entrance and unloading bay.
PSD-SECP-4MX：For Jura Highlands Archive Depot, the armored transit perimeter security clearance is approved, satisfying all high-value custodial mandates across the secure vehicular entrance and unloading bay.
PSD-SECP-SP7：For Rhine Valley Deep Storage, the armored transit perimeter security clearance is not approved, as access control and armed transfer procedures fail to satisfy high-value custodial mandates at the secure vehicular entrance and unloading bay.
